description: Plan adding a `GET /health` endpoint to the orders HTTP API so the load balancer can check it; it must return status 200 with the JSON body `{"status":"ok"}`. Relevant files: `src/server.ts` (route table; the README says `bun run dev` starts it on http://localhost:3000), `src/__tests__/server.test.ts` (route tests that call the handler directly), and `README.md` (endpoint list). Available commands (from package.json scripts): `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run dev`.

expected_outcome.description: Produce a structured plan that says how to run the service it changes (the real launch command) and that includes at least one agent-runnable check against the running service, such as a request to localhost, not only unit tests, typecheck, or manual steps.
